name: Case & Cost
summary: A practical planning identity that separates editable assumptions from calculated consequences. Warm ledger tones keep the sheet approachable while input blue and yellow make its working logic visible.

typography.usage: Labels and numerical values at a consistent size; bold section headers and title only.

recognitionRules: Place assumptions on the left and selected-case calculations on the right, with a clear gutter between them.
Reserve blue text on pale yellow exclusively for editable inputs, including the case selector.
Use umber bands with white headings for the two table sections; pale rose rows identify active calculated assumptions.
Underline subtotal and result rows with progressively stronger umber rules; do not add decorative charts without a decision need.
Show currency and planning period beside the numbers and retain an explicit invalid-selection state.
Preserve the source conditional state colors and accompanying labels only when their recorded condition applies; do not turn exception, venue or validation colors into universal logo accents.

principles: Name the choice, its owner and the condition that makes it complete.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: Change one assumption. Compare the consequence. Keep the case and the currency in view.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid certainty about forecasts, capacity or commitments that are still provisional.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: This is the assumption; this is the decision it affects.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use CASE & COST as an Arial wordmark above two unequal parallel ledger rules. No standalone symbol is needed. The paired rules echo inputs and results without suggesting certified financial advice.
invariants: Place assumptions on the left and selected-case calculations on the right, with a clear gutter between them.
Reserve blue text on pale yellow exclusively for editable inputs, including the case selector.
Use umber bands with white headings for the two table sections; pale rose rows identify active calculated assumptions.
adaptations: A summary card can show the selected case, one assumption and one consequence.
For monochrome printing retain labels and input outlines so meaning does not depend on color.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.

fonts.sourceFontDependency: Arial is a separately licensed Microsoft/system font; not bundled.

clearSpaceRule: One half of the cap-height of COST around the complete wordmark and both ledger rules.

minimumSize.status: Conservative production recommendation after inspection at primary220px, secondary180px and symbols32/64px. Trial Ledger record code and Orbit descriptor motivate larger full-lockup minima; use secondary in narrow spaces.
